name: dead-claude-skills
description: deadmade's personal Claude Code setup: own skills plus the third-party plugins used on every machine.

plugins.name: dead-skills
plugins.description: Default bundle: global instructions, the Night City theme and mod (spinner words, status-line reactions), desktop notifications, Context7, and core plugins from claude-plugins-official as dependencies.

plugins.name: nix-lsp
plugins.description: Nix language server (nixd) for code intelligence (requires nixd on PATH)

plugins.name: mcp-github
plugins.description: GitHub's hosted MCP server (repos, issues, PRs, Actions). Opt-in per machine.

plugins.name: mcp-azure
plugins.description: Azure DevOps Server MCP server (self-hosted, PAT). Opt-in per machine, configure with /plugin configure.

plugins.name: atlassian
plugins.description: Atlassian's official plugin: Rovo MCP server for Jira and Confluence (OAuth sign-in via /mcp) plus skills. Opt-in.

plugins.name: rust-skills
plugins.description: Rust best practices from Apollo GraphQL's handbook (rust-best-practices): ownership, errors, clippy, testing, dispatch. Vendored, synced weekly. Opt-in.

plugins.name: csharp-skills
plugins.description: Microsoft's .NET skills (dotnet/skills): C#, testing, MSBuild/NuGet, ASP.NET Core, Blazor, EF Core, MAUI, WinForms, behind six C#-only router skills. Vendored, synced weekly. Opt-in.

plugins.name: postgres
plugins.description: Postgres best practices (Neon's postgres-best-practices) and safe, non-blocking migrations (Timescale pg-aiguide's postgres-database-migration). Vendored, synced weekly. Opt-in.

plugins.name: graphify
plugins.description: Graphify: turn a codebase into a queryable knowledge graph (/graphify). Needs the graphify CLI (uv tool install graphifyy). Opt-in.

plugins.name: flows
plugins.description: Conductor skills that run the rest of the marketplace in order, with approval gates and resumable state: /feature-flow, /research-flow, /implement, /fix-flow and /upgrade build; /test-audit, /doc-audit and /harden check a branch or the whole repo; /self-review reviews your branch before a PR and /verify proves it is ready for one; /understand teaches a codebase; /learn saves what a flow taught. Also a writing skill (Williams and Bizup's Style) with a copyedit in which an Opus editor revises a document by that skill, and a code-only prose check on each Write or Edit of a Markdown file. Carries its skill packs, which only its conductors read, and installs the other plugins they use. Opt-in.

plugins.name: hallmark
plugins.description: Hallmark: anti-AI-slop design skill for web frontends, scoped to browser UI work. Vendored from nutlope/hallmark. Opt-in.

plugins.name: tui-review
plugins.description: /tui-review: a fast, stacked-branch-aware diff pane beside the chat, so you can ask Claude about what you read. Needs the tui-review binary, which the installer downloads. Opt-in.

plugins.name: web-mcp
plugins.description: Web research tools for Claude: search (Google, Bing, DuckDuckGo and Brave read in web-mcp's own browser, paper APIs plus Google Scholar and Semantic Scholar, ranked with BM25), fetch (whole pages as markdown, optionally with images), browser (via agent-browser) and lookup (passive DNS, RDAP, certificate, Wayback, IP and vulnerability records). Everything is archived in .web/. Needs the web-mcp binary and agent-browser, which the installer downloads. Opt-in.

plugins.name: md-pane
plugins.description: Click a .md path in Claude's reply to read it, rendered, in a pane beside the chat (fullscreen terminal). Opt-in.
